bullets: • **SBI Small Cap Fund** charges an exit load of **1.0%** if units are redeemed before the stipulated holding period, making it the highest exit load among the three funds listed in the provided context.

• **SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund** has an exit load of **0%**, meaning no exit load fee is charged upon redemption; however, it carries a mandatory **3-year lock-in period** during which redemption is not permitted.

• **SBI Large Cap Fund (Bluechip)** has a tiered exit load structure: **0.25%** if redeemed within **0–30 days** and **0.10%** if redeemed within **30–90 days**, as per the detailed fund data provided.
• Exit load is a fee charged to investors for redeeming or "exiting" a mutual fund before a stipulated period; it is deducted from the redemption amount and is **not** a flat fee paid separately.

• All three funds carry a **Very High risk level** as per the provided context, with expense ratios (Direct Plan) of **0.79%** (Small Cap), **0.99%** (ELSS Tax Saver), and **0.84%** (Large Cap Bluechip).
